# Repo Health Checklist

Use this checklist when you want a quick maintenance pass on the repository.

## Check the basics

- Confirm the default branch is up to date with origin.
- Check for uncommitted local changes.
- Check for open PRs that still need attention.
- Check recent workflow results on the default branch.

## Check the docs

- Confirm `AGENTS.md` still matches the current workflow.
- Confirm `REPOSITORY-CONTEXT.md` still matches the current repo facts.
- Confirm any governance or template docs are still current.

## Check the memory

- Review `.agents/memory/decisions.md` for stale decisions.
- Review `.agents/memory/lessons.md` for lessons that should now be reflected in docs.

## When to use

- After a cluster of documentation changes
- Before handing the repo off to someone else
- When you want a quick sanity check before starting new work
